segments.text: Good evening and welcome to the program. Tonight we are talking about city gardens.
Thanks for having me. It is great to be here.
So tell us, how did the project start?
It started with an empty lot behind the library and a few neighbors who wanted tomatoes.
And a lot of paperwork, honestly.
We spent almost a year getting the permits signed.
How many people take part now?
About two hundred families, and the waiting list keeps growing every season.
Which is a good problem to have.
What would you tell someone who wants to start one in their own town?
Talk to the neighbors first. Then find a small corner of land and just begin.
Wonderful advice. Thank you both for coming in tonight.
